item.description: By Our Reporter The Foundation for Peace Professionals (PeacePro) has raised the alarm over a rapidly escalating Hausa–Fulani insurgency in North-West Nigeria, following a fact finding mission to the region in January led by Executive Director Abdulrazaq Hamzat. item.title: Kaduna Kidnapping: Gbenga Hashim Accuses FG, Security Agencies of Complicity
item.description: By Our Reporter Former presidential candidate, Gbenga Hashim, has accused the Federal Government and security agencies of complicity in Nigeria’s worsening insecurity, following the recent kidnapping of over 170 persons in Kajuru Local Government Area of Kaduna State. item.description: By Dare Akogun A Kwara-based fact-checking organisation, Fact Check Africa, has emerged as one of the beneficiaries of a $750,000 global grant awarded by the International Fact-Checking Network (IFCN) at the Poynter Institute to support credible journalism and combat misinformation.
